description:
Goal
Replace the single per-root DeriveTransportPlan job with per-executable DeriveExecutableTransport(E) facts, leaving the cross-executable closure in a thin root fan-in. This caches the expensive per-executable projection (the Tarjan/memo/local-solve bulk and the enum_take_drop_split cost) and delivers blast-radius-by-revision.

What
- Add Job::DeriveExecutableTransport(ExecutableKey) + FactKey::ExecutableTransport(ExecutableKey) (drive.rs ~38/76), dispatched in jobs/mod.rs. Mirror the DeriveRuntimeDemand skeleton (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:155-258): gate on Executable(E)/SemanticClosed, read settled ActivationAnalyzed/ReturnType/LoweredBody/RuntimeDemand/CallSiteSummary, output the per-executable fact, enqueue follow-ups on misses.
- ExecutableTransport(E) carries E intra-executable positions, its callable/boundary drafts, its CallArg shapes, and its publication-source data. ExecutableInput is projected PROVISIONALLY from own-demand (no caller merge yet).
- derive_transport_plan(root) (jobs/transport.rs:551) becomes a FAN-IN: read all ExecutableTransport(E) in the closure, run the EXISTING cross-executable closure (collect_executable_input_constraints, return-sharing, expand/resolve, derive_codegen_seam_facts) to assemble a byte-identical TransportPlan.
- Barrier KEPT: each DeriveExecutableTransport gated on SemanticClosed(root).

Where / notes
- MemoKey already includes ExecutableKey (jobs/transport.rs:90) so per-executable scoping loses no memo sharing.
- Seed per-executable jobs the way the seal seeds DeriveRuntimeDemand (jobs/root.rs:303-318).

Verify
shadow==monolith (semantic_analysis_test.rs:819-872) green; transport_contract_test.rs (~70 tests) green; transport_validation.rs on-define check green; zero warnings.
title: Stage 1: per-executable ExecutableTransport(E) facts; DeriveTransportPlan becomes a fan-in
